title: piebird catalog.json
description: The hand-written plugin list tools/build.ts turns into the omp, Claude Code and Codex marketplace files. Uniqueness of entry names, the match between entries and plugins/<name>/, and the tern host's so.stencil.tern/ folder are checked in tools/build.ts.

plugins.description: Output order of the marketplace entries.

hosts.description: Where the plugin runs. Tern has no marketplace: a plugin with the tern host keeps its Tern plugin in so.stencil.tern/ and needs the omp host, whose part installs it.

development.description: Hosts whose part (com.anthropic.claudecode/, com.openai/) is still in development: built and tested, but the build leaves it out of the manifest that host reads.

program.description: The plugin's native program, when it has one: its Go source is cmd/<program>/, with the plugin's settings.json beside it, and the build puts it in the plugin's native/ under this name, the command people and agents run.

name.description: A name omp, Claude Code and Codex all accept: kebab-case, at most 64 characters, without "claude" or "anthropic". Also applied to plugin.json name.
